title: XBio
description: A sleek, rounded UI overhaul with the signature cyan highlights for XBio: Othersider.
body:
XBio: Othersider – Official UI Resource Pack

This is the official companion resource pack for the XBio: Othersider modpack. It completely overhauls the vanilla Minecraft interface to deliver a clean, minimalist, and modern visual experience.

Key Features:

Sleek Rounded Corners: All buttons, panels, and containers feature smooth rounded corners, moving away from the harsh edges of the default UI.

Signature XBio Aesthetic: Utilizes the pack's signature cyan ( #54fcfc ) as a highlight color for active states and selections, perfectly matching the modpack’s tech-inspired theme.

Minimalist Design: A refined light-gray and dark-gray palette with subtle white borders ensures maximum readability without cluttering your screen.

Custom Elements: Includes custom textures for main menu buttons, option sliders, text fields, and the background.
